subject: Collaborative evaluation roadmap — starter docs
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhou <emma@helios.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Collaborative evaluation roadmap — starter docs

Hi Emma,

Great speaking with you earlier — thanks again for the time. As promised, I put together a lightweight starter pack to help Helios run a short, outcomes-focused evaluation and get to a purchase decision within a predictable window. The two artifacts attached (and linked below) are intentionally concise so we can co-edit:

- A one-page Mutual Action Plan (Google Doc) with roles, milestones, and acceptance criteria
- A two-slide executive summary template you can give to your procurement/stakeholders

Key asks:
- Please review the MAP and add your internal stakeholders + prefered dates for milestone owners (column on the right).
- Confirm the top 2 "success metrics" Helios will use to accept the pilot.
- If the timeline looks tight, mark the milestones you’d like to relax — we can propose options.

Proposed timeline (starter):
1) Kickoff & success criteria sign-off — week of Nov 29
2) Pilot setup & test prompts/data injection — week of Dec 6
3) Evaluation & quality review — week of Dec 13
4) Exec review & procurement decision — week of Dec 20

Links & attachments:
- Google Doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_Redwood_MAP_Starter
- Slides: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B_MAP_Template_Slides
- Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Starter_20261121.gdoc (stub), MAP_Template_Slides_Starter.pptx

I'll be on travel next week but available for a 30-min sync on Nov 30 (PST) if that works for your team. Marissa will lead day-to-day operations on the pilot. Sean will handle SLA/cost questions if procurement raises them.

If you'd rather we convert the MAP into your internal template, tell us which columns to keep — we'll adapt.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Starter_20261121.gdoc (Google Doc stub)
Attachment: MAP_Template_Slides_Starter.pptx (PowerPoint stub)

From: Emma Zhou <emma@helios.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Collaborative evaluation roadmap — starter docs

Thanks Kimberly — this is exactly what we needed to move internally. A few quick notes after a first pass:

- The MAP looks good; can you add an SLA/uptime expectation row for the pilot? Procurement will ask.
- Please add a column for acceptance thresholds (e.g., precision/recall or NPS delta) — our ML team prefers numeric gates.
- Can we make the exec slide a one-pager instead of two slides? That helps with our leadership deck.

I added Tom Li (tom.li@helios.ai) to the doc as an editor — he’ll call out technical owners and metrics.

I’m available for a 30-min call Nov 30 at 11:00am PST if Kimberly can do it.

Best,
Emma
Head of Product | Helios AI
emma@helios.ai

Subject: Re: Collaborative evaluation roadmap — starter docs

Thanks Emma — good flags. I made three small edits in the doc (comments and a suggested row):

1) Added an SLA row for pilot scope: Target 99.5% availability for inference endpoints (non-production), with 99% as minimum for trial acceptance.
2) Added an "Acceptance thresholds" column with two suggested metrics: a) classification F1 >= 0.78 on the validation set b) user satisfaction >= 4.0/5 on a 200-user sample.
3) Condensed the exec slides into a single one-pager and attached a revised PPT stub under the Drive link.

Next actions I propose:
- Kimberly to confirm dates that work for kickoff and staffing.
- Emma/Tom to confirm metrics and add internal approvers in the MAP.
- I'll prepare a short runbook for connecting Helios test data and a checklist for data handling and redaction.

Suggested immediate milestone change: push pilot setup window to Dec 7 (we have a holiday on Dec 6) — updated in the doc.

Also, FYI: procurement may request a short Data Processing Addendum; Sean, can you flag standard timelines so we set expectations?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
